placements.why: This envelope's content (a test case built to reproduce a named prod failure pattern and assert required outcomes) is organizational-proof-grain content — nothing in the supplied strata (currently empty) covers validation/testing work, and the existing narrative structure (ns__Strategy's diagnostic-methodology decisions) is a different organizational category (client-engagement strategy, not internal proof/QA work). Minting the category the content itself names, standalone, since no existing strata entry is even close.
placements.title: Validation work earns its own organizational category
placements.frame: what does this artifact prove, and what evidence does it produce that a fix holds under the real failure conditions it targets?

placements.title: Regression tests are built to reproduce and guard against known production failures
placements.frame: what production failure pattern is this test reproducing, and what must remain true of the system's behavior (no crash, valid output) for the fix to be considered proven?
placements.why: src-1 names the specific prod failure pattern being reproduced (missing-id, markdown heading with no id field) and src-2 states the acceptance criteria that reproduction must satisfy (must not crash; must produce a valid slug). Together these are not a one-time fact but a recurring theme this repo will keep feeding as more regression/e2e cases reproduce other prod failure patterns and assert required outcomes against them — the narrative grain test is met. No existing leaf (ns__Decision_DiagnosticFirst, ns__Decision_KnowledgeMapping) touches testing or failure reproduction; both live under client-engagement Strategy, a different subject entirely. Minted fresh under the newly-minted Proof strata since nothing existing is even close.
